product.name: Monoprice 2-Port Cat6 RJ45 Surface Mount Box - UL Dual IDC 50u TAA No Logo White
product.description: This white plastic box is a surface‑mounted dual Cat6 keystone box intended for use when in‑wall or other installations are not possible. The cover can be easily removed to allow access to the wire connections. Use a 110D or Krone type impact to crimp and connect the wires. It can be used with stranded or solid Cat6 cable of any gauge. It includes double‑sided tape and two screws, allowing you to choose the mounting method that best fits your needs. Installation instructions are included.Support Files: User's Manual (Aug 14, 2012)Diagram (Feb 02, 2023)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
